scientific_integrity: The analytical rank defect proves the continuum theorem. Exact-rational finite checks are supporting tests, not exhaustive proofs. Earliest primary preprint date distinguishes first public appearance from later revisions.
scientific_limitations: Only the sufficient non-frame interval at density 3/4 for the symmetric order-two B-spline is proved. No exact global frame-set boundary or independent verification is claimed.
title: A doubled rational-density non-frame slit for the triangular B-spline
